skill.name: design-orchestration
skill.description: Coordinates design workflows by routing ideas through brainstorming, risk assessment, review, and execution readiness checks.
skill.summary: Routes design work through validation steps before implementation begins.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All six static alerts are false positives caused by inline Markdown code formatting around skill names. I found no evidence of shell execution, prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious workflow intent in SKILL.md.

content.value_statement: Design work often moves to implementation before risks are clear. This skill routes ideas through brainstorming, review, and readiness checks before execution.
actual_capabilities: Routes new design work to brainstorming before implementation planning.
Classifies designs as low, moderate, or high risk using stated criteria.
Requires multi-agent review for high-risk design decisions.
Checks for approved designs, complete decision logs, documented assumptions, and acknowledged risks.
Blocks implementation when required design artifacts are missing.
limitations: It does not create the design content itself.
It depends on separate brainstorming and review skills being available.
It does not validate code correctness after implementation starts.
It provides process control, not domain-specific technical judgment.

use_cases.title: Feature Design Intake
use_cases.description: Route a new feature idea through brainstorming, risk classification, and a clear next step.

use_cases.title: Architecture Change Review
use_cases.description: Require deeper review before a high-impact system design reaches implementation planning.

use_cases.title: Implementation Gatekeeping
use_cases.description: Confirm that design approval, decision logs, assumptions, and risks are complete before work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Design Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin from a new idea with no validated design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration for this feature idea. Identify the required next skill, required artifacts, and the first decision log entry.

prompt_templates.title: Classify Design Risk
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess a completed brainstorm before planning implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to classify this design as low, moderate, or high risk. Explain the risk factors and required next step.

prompt_templates.title: Check Review Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a design for multi-agent critique.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to verify whether this design is ready for multi-agent review. List missing artifacts and block review if needed.

prompt_templates.title: Gate Implementation
prompt_templates.scenario: Decide whether an approved design can move to execution.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use design-orchestration to run an execution readiness check. Confirm approval, decision logs, assumptions, risks, and the explicit next step.

output_examples.input: A team proposes replacing the billing authorization flow with a new service.
output_examples.output: The skill classifies the change as high risk and requires multi-agent-brainstorming before implementation planning.

output_examples.input: A small settings page improvement has a completed design and decision log.
output_examples.output: The skill allows implementation planning because the design is low risk and required artifacts are present.

output_examples.input: A design review is requested, but assumptions and risk notes are missing.
output_examples.output: The skill blocks execution and routes the work back to complete the missing design artifacts.

best_practices: Run this skill before implementation planning begins.
Keep decision logs current as the design changes.
Use stricter review when user impact, uncertainty, or irreversibility is high.
anti_patterns: Using the skill after implementation has already started.
Treating moderate or high risk work as low risk to save time.
Skipping documented assumptions because the design seems obvious.

faq.question: Does this skill generate designs?
faq.answer: No. It routes design work through other skills and checks whether required artifacts exist.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when a feature, system change, or design decision needs structured review before implementation.

faq.question: Does it require multi-agent review every time?
faq.answer: No. It recommends review for moderate risk and requires it for high-risk designs.

faq.question: Can it approve implementation?
faq.answer: It can allow implementation planning when approval, decision logs, assumptions, and risks are complete.

faq.question: What happens when artifacts are missing?
faq.answer: The skill blocks execution and routes the work back to the appropriate design or review step.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
